thread:
Maria: Quick sync — can we finalize how quota tiers map to pricing plans? Need concrete numbers for free/pro/enterprise and burst/enforcement behavior. (sync today? :eyes:)
Ashok: I can sketch a proposal. Are we doing both per-org monthly token buckets + per-key TPS limits?
Tess: yes, product wants per-org monthly for billing and per-key TPS for fair-share + short burst windows
Kevin: also need to clarify soft vs hard enforcement. Free should be soft (warnings, header signals). Pro/Ent can be hard depending on contract.
Maria: Proposed behaviors: Free -> monthly token cap + short burst with guidance; Pro -> higher cap + modest hard TPS cap; Enterprise -> contractable caps and custom burst windows.
Olivia: Telemetry note: emit events `quota.check`, `quota.exceeded`, `throttle.applied`, `quota.warning`. Include org_id, key_id, plan_tier, decision, route.
RateBot: ratebot: enforcement log sample: {"ts":"2026-03-01T14:22:09Z","org":"rwd-42","key":"sk-abc","action":"throttle","reason":"burst_limit"}
Ashok: Ballpark numbers to discuss: Free = 100k tokens/mo, burst 10 TPS with 30s window; Pro = 5M tokens/mo, burst 50 TPS with 60s window; Enterprise = 100M+ tokens/mo, burst negotiable (200+ TPS).
Tess: Need separate accounting for embeddings vs generations. UI should show `token_unit` and `embedding_unit` consumption.
Maria: UX: console shows usage bar + projected overrun date and a prominent "Request increase" button for Pro/Ent. Free shows banner at 80% + email/webhook alert.
Kevin: Enforcement sequence idea: 1) include rate-limit headers (`X-RateLimit-Remaining`), 2) at 80% emit `quota.warning` and show UI prompt, 3) on monthly cap: Free -> 429 + upgrade CTA; Pro -> 429 or `Retry-After` if within burst allowance; Ent -> if contract allows, create `quota.overage` billing event instead of hard 429.
Maria: Migration rule: keys with no plan field default to Free until billing info exists. Add `plan_migrated` flag to track migration attempts.
Olivia: Dashboard telemetry needs per-route breakdown and a cost-delta estimate when users toggle batching/quantization suggestions.
Ashok: Draft config snippet for enforcement we can iterate on:
```
{
  "plans": {
    "free": {"monthly_tokens":100000, "burst_tps":10, "burst_window_s":30, "soft":true},
    "pro": {"monthly_tokens":5000000, "burst_tps":50, "burst_window_s":60, "soft":false},
    "enterprise": {"monthly_tokens":100000000, "burst_tps":200, "burst_window_s":60, "soft":false, "overage_allowed":true}
  }
}
```
Kevin: Add `per_key_tps` override and `org_level_pooling` toggle (some customers want pooled org throughput rather than per-key throttles).
Tess: For rollout, gate enforcement behind FF `quota_v2_enforced` so we can canary 5% of orgs and ramp.
Maria: Action items: Ashok write RFC with numbers + migration plan; Olivia enumerate telemetry fields; Tess mock console banners/flows; Kevin add per-key override config to runtime. PRs by EOD Wed?
Ashok: I'll start the RFC today and post the link here. :+1:
Deploy Bot: scheduled rollout: `quota_v2_enforced` flag to 5% canary at 2026-03-05T02:00Z
Maria: Thanks everyone — we'll review RFC tomorrow morning.
